reason: The quadratic seed has relative error up to ~1.2e-3 near mantissa 1.7 (e.g. f(1.7)=1.1949 vs cbrt(1.7)≈1.1935), and a single Newton iteration only squares the relative error (~1.4e-6), which exceeds the required 1e-6 relative tolerance for many legal FP16 inputs, before even counting fp32 rounding in the polynomial evaluation.
